verdict.rationale: Relay documents outbound international wires that can send same-day, with the exact delivery estimate shown before confirming. A community review describes the international transfer system as easy to use, with straightforward pricing of $10 per outgoing transfer, waived on the Pro plan. However, nothing shows Relay can send in local or foreign currencies rather than USD, and nothing discloses FX rates or markups, so the local-currency and full fee-transparency parts of the story are unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of sending in local/foreign currencies, disclosed FX rates or markups, and first-party documentation of the international fee schedule.
